title: OpenEvoShield：面向开放世界多智能体系统攻击的双重非平稳持续防御
summary: 提出OpenEvoShield，一种针对LLM多智能体系统的共演化持续防御框架。通过非对称速率控制器、正常边界更新器、EWC正则化策略集成和能量多粒度检测器，应对攻击策略和智能体行为的双重动态变化。在五个基准和四种拓扑上，优于静态和持续基线，能检测大多数未见攻击并保持低误报率。
summary_en: Proposes OpenEvoShield, a co-evolutionary continual defense framework for LLM-based multi-agent systems. It handles dual dynamics of attack strategies and agent behavior drifts using asymmetric rate control, normal-boundary update, EWC-regularized policy ensemble, and energy-based multi-granularity detection. Outperforms baselines across five benchmarks and four topologies.
